name: Monomark Engineering (India)
summary: Monomark Engineering, based in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, provides industrial operations and maintenance, metal fabrication and project execution for metals, cement, ports and engineering clients. Revenue grew from ₹390 cr in FY24 to ₹562 cr in FY26, and profit rose 42% in FY26 to ₹25.9 cr, though operating cash flow was only ₹8.1 cr. The issue is a fresh issue of 2.70 crore shares with no offer for sale, and ₹120 cr of it is earmarked for working capital, not new capacity. Customer concentration is very high: the top 10 customers gave 91% of FY26 revenue and Hindustan Zinc alone 35%; the price band is not yet announced.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹389.9 cr (FY24) to ₹561.9 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 20.1%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹389.9 cr, ₹475.0 cr, ₹561.9 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.77 at June 30, 2026 (borrowings ₹92.1 cr vs net worth ₹119.3 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 9% (₹80.2 cr to ₹87.3 cr) while revenue rose 44% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹60.1 cr, ₹73.3 cr, ₹116.7 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹8.1 cr in FY26, about 31% of the ₹25.9 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 42.2% in FY26, from ₹18.2 cr to ₹25.9 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from 3.80% (FY24) to 3.83% (FY25) and 4.61% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on equity was 27.27% in FY26 (RoNW 22.19%).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 21.47% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: The price band is not announced, so the post-issue P/E cannot be computed (peer median P/E is about 31.5x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: The price band is not announced, so the post-issue price to book cannot be computed.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: The price band is not announced, so the post-issue market cap to sales cannot be computed.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: The price band is not announced; the last reported private allotment was in July 2025 at ₹38 a share.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 65.69% after the issue, down from 91.37%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: The offer document states none of the promoters' shares are pledged.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: FY26 related-party payments (promoter pay ₹2.67 cr plus about ₹1.3 cr of equipment, rent and reimbursements to a promoter firm) are under 1% of revenue.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: Tax proceedings of ₹13.1 lakh are pending against the promoters.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The entire issue of 2.70 crore shares is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The 2.70 crore new shares are about 28.1% of the 9.60 crore post-issue shares.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: Nothing funds capex, expansion or acquisitions; ₹120 cr goes to working capital and the rest to general corporate purposes.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: None of the fresh issue goes to repaying debt.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The general corporate purposes amount is not disclosed (capped at 25%), as the issue size isn't fixed yet.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: No proceeds go to repaying loans, so none repay promoter entities.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Tax proceedings against the company total ₹1.20 cr, about 1% of the ₹116.7 cr net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: An independent director faces a ₹20 lakh cheque-dishonour complaint and a separate criminal matter.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities are ₹56.5 cr, about 47.3% of net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top 10 customers gave 91.2% of FY26 revenue, and Hindustan Zinc alone 35.4%.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Supplier concentration figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated in September 2005, so about 21 years of operating history.
